if(sum(left.end) == sum(right.end))

if(sum(left.end) >0 && sum(right.end)>0 )

which confirms that reduce.key is in both ends

On Thu, Jul 19, 2012 at 9:00 AM, Saptarshi Guha <saptars...@gmail.com> wrote:
Here
Download rhipe from https://github.com/downloads/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/Rhipe_0.69.tar.gz (I just added rhoptions()$template$raggregate)

## a1.txt:

## a,12345
## b,89394
## c,12534
## a,12312345

## a2.txt:

## a,"32 road","red"
## b,"albaniaa","night"
## d,"netritia","daytime"
## a,"32 road","blue"

rhput("~/tmp/a1.txt","/user/sguha/tmp")
rhput("~/tmp/a2.txt","/user/sguha/tmp")
which.discrim <- function(left,right){
  return(function(input.file.name){
    if(grepl(sprintf("%s",left), input.file.name)) 'left'
    else if(grepl(sprintf("%s",right), input.file.name)) 'right'
    else NA
  })
}
discrim <- which.discrim("a1.txt","a2.txt")
   
m <- rhmap({
  cols <- strsplit(r,",")[[1]]
  w <- discrim(Sys.getenv("mapred.input.file"))
  rhcollect(cols[1], list(w, cols[-1]))
})

reduce <- rhoptions()$templates$raggregate({
  adata <- unlist(adata, recursive = FALSE)
  left.end <- unlist(lapply(adata, function(r) r[[1]]=="left"))
  right.end <- unlist(lapply(adata, function(r) r[[1]]=="right"))
  if(sum(left.end) == sum(right.end)){
    ## i assume same number of rows in either side
    left.end <- do.call(rbind,lapply(adata[left.end],"[[",2))
    right.end <- do.call(rbind,lapply(adata[right.end],"[[",2))
    rhcollect(reduce.key, cbind(left.end,right.end))
  }
})
j <- rhwatch(rhmr(map=m,reduce=reduce,inout=c('text','seq')
                  ,param=list(discrim=discrim)
                  ,ifolder=c("/user/sguha/tmp/a1.txt","/user/sguha/tmp/a2.txt")))

## RHIPE: Read 2 pairs occupying 153 bytes, deserializing


HTH
Sapsi

Hello,
Checked on my end. This code works assuming you have the latest Rhipe.


rhput("a1.txt","/user/sguha/tmp/tmpL/")
rhput("a2.txt","/user/sguha/tmp/tmpR/")

which.discrim <- function(left,right){
  return(function(input.file.name){
    if(grepl(sprintf("%s",left), input.file.name)) 'left'
    else if(grepl(sprintf("%s",right), input.file.name)) 'right'
    else NA
  })
}
discrim <- which.discrim(left="tmpL",right="tmpR")

m <- rhmap({
  cols <- strsplit(r,",")[[1]]
  w <- discrim(Sys.getenv("mapred.input.file"))
  rhcollect(cols[1], list(w, cols[-1]))
})

reduce <- rhoptions()$templates$raggregate({
  adata     <- unlist(adata, recursive = FALSE)
  left.end  <- unlist(lapply(adata, function(r) r[[1]]=="left"))
  right.end <- unlist(lapply(adata, function(r) r[[1]]=="right"))

left.end  <- do.call(rbind,lapply(adata[left.end],"[[",2))
  right.end <- do.call(rbind,lapply(adata[right.end],"[[",2))
  rhcollect(reduce.key, cbind(left.end,right.end))
})
j <- rhwatch(rhmr(map=m,reduce=reduce,inout=c('text','seq')
                  ,param=list(discrim=discrim)

,ifolder=c("/user/sguha/tmp/tmpL","/user/sguha/tmp/tmpR")
                  ))

print(j)


--- /user/sguha/tmp/tmpR/a2.txt ---

b,"albaniaa","night"
d,"netritia","daytime"
a,"920302 road","red"

--- /user/sguha/tmp/tmpL/a1.txt
a,12345
b,89394
c,12534
a, 1123129031231
